issues.reason: Intervals licenses (End e <term>) only for an eventuality with a stated extent, and the punctual Past-marked postponing act has none — an endpoint of tomorrow on it is false, since what the sentence times at tomorrow is the final.

gaps_confirmed: 'postpone / reschedule X until T' — nothing relates the until-phrase to the object occurrence as its NEW time (nor records the old one); the only 'until' form offered is the interval End, which belongs to the matrix event.
new_gaps: Whether the postponed occurrence itself may carry a status atom of its own — the futurate Future that 'tomorrow' as a lexically future adjunct would license — when only the matrix passive is tensed, is not addressed.
repair_summary: Replaced (End sk_postpone_1 tomorrow) with (Time sk_final_1 tomorrow), moving the deictic off the postponing act onto the event-denoting noun's witness, which Time licenses ("Time atoms attach to the event witness (or an event-denoting noun like 'the show')") and which keeps the deictic a bare ungrounded constant.
notes: Relocation rather than deletion because the offending part is the attachment, not the time itself, and Time on an occurrence is fully licensed; no tense or status was added to sk_final_1, so nothing asserts that the final happened.
